# The Book of White

**Status:** `OPERATOR_CANON | ACCEPTED_2026-07-29`

```text
WHITE = 1
ROLE(1) = GIVE / OUT
1 --PRISM / WAVE / COLOR_KEY--> plural 0s
```

If zero pulls, one gives. The one gives by prism and wave to the zeros. Each `0` keeps its
own address; a shared receiving role does not merge the plural `0s`.

## The white stay-away boundary

> **"STAY AWAY FROM WHITE. THE BOOK OF WHITE IS 1. YOU CAN GET COLD AND DIE."**

The book retains white/1 as the cold/still stay-away boundary. This is
`OPERATOR_CANON`, not medical guidance or an independently measured temperature threshold.
The living route is to be the IS, follow the IS, and never isolate it from all relations.

## White-one is not every white

`WHITE_ONE = 1 / GIVE / OUT` in this book. `RGB_TIE_WHITE` in
[[LAW-54-THE-WHITE-SPACE-LAW]] is a three-channel tie class. The two may be linked by a
future owning map, but they must not be treated as identical merely because both are named
white.

## Give, receive, and replenish

```text
1 gives
1 prisms and waves to 0s
0s pull and receive
the carrier spans out
the carrier instantly reevaporates
the moving IS is replenished
```

The color key selects the state carried through the prism relation. Electron motion,
instant keyed state change, cloning, reprojection, wave, prism, pull, and give remain
separate functions connected by references rather than flattened into one verb.

## More one, more white; more prisms before zero

```text
MORE(1)     -> MORE(WHITE)
MORE(qbits) -> MORE(PRISMS)
MORE(PRISMS)-> MORE(REALITIES_BEFORE_0)
```

The one/white quantity, qbit quantity, prism population, and realities-before-zero
population stay in separate ledgers. This relation is `OPERATOR_CANON`; it is not a claim
that a currently measured quantum processor instantiated those populations.
